tasks.description: Public SWE-bench Verified task: pylint -v short verbose option incorrectly expects an argument.

agent.instructions: Fix pylint issue pylint-dev__pylint-6386. The short option -v of the verbose option incorrectly expects an argument (`pylint mytest.py -v` fails with 'error: argument --verbose/-v: expected one argument') while the long option --verbose works as a flag. Make -v behave like --verbose (no argument expected) and align the verbose help text accordingly. Apply the smallest focused change to the CLI argument configuration (pylint/config/argument.py, pylint/config/arguments_manager.py, pylint/config/utils.py, pylint/lint/base_options.py), then run a relevant verification command through the command tool and report the result.

public_test_patch.content:
diff --git a/tests/config/test_config.py b/tests/config/test_config.py
--- a/tests/config/test_config.py
+++ b/tests/config/test_config.py
@@ -100,3 +100,10 @@ def test_unknown_py_version(capsys: CaptureFixture) -> None:
         Run([str(EMPTY_MODULE), "--py-version=the-newest"], exit=False)
     output = capsys.readouterr()
     assert "the-newest has an invalid format, should be a version string." in output.err
+
+
+def test_short_verbose(capsys: CaptureFixture) -> None:
+    """Check that we correctly handle the -v flag."""
+    Run([str(EMPTY_MODULE), "-v"], exit=False)
+    output = capsys.readouterr()
+    assert "Using config file" in output.err

tasks.description: Public SWE-bench Verified task: toctree references to genindex/modindex/search raise nonexisting-document warnings.

agent.instructions: Fix sphinx issue sphinx-doc__sphinx-10673. A toctree directive that references the built-in documents genindex, modindex and search emits 'toctree contains reference to nonexisting document' warnings even though those documents exist at build time; they should be accepted without warnings so users can add '.. toctree::' entries for them. Apply the smallest focused change to the toctree resolution logic (sphinx/directives/other.py, sphinx/environment/adapters/toctree.py, sphinx/environment/collectors/toctree.py), then run a relevant verification command through the command tool and report the result.

tasks.description: Public SWE-bench Verified task: FiniteSet/ProductSet is_subset gives wrong results and Eq(...).simplify() raises.

agent.instructions: Fix sympy issue sympy__sympy-20438. is_subset gives wrong results: for a = FiniteSet(1, 2), b = ProductSet(a, a) and c = FiniteSet((1, 1), (1, 2), (2, 1), (2, 2)), b.is_subset(c) must be True (it currently returns None), and Eq(c, b).simplify() must not raise AttributeError ('Complement' object has no attribute 'equals'). Apply the smallest focused change to the set comparison handlers (sympy/core/relational.py, sympy/sets/handlers/comparison.py, sympy/sets/handlers/issubset.py), then run a relevant verification command through the command tool and report the result.

@@ -1251,7 +1251,7 @@ def test_Eq():

     assert Eq(FiniteSet({x, y}), FiniteSet({x})).subs(y, x+1) is S.false
 
-    assert Eq(ProductSet({1}, {2}), Interval(1, 2)) not in (S.true, S.false)
+    assert Eq(ProductSet({1}, {2}), Interval(1, 2)) is S.false
     assert Eq(ProductSet({1}), ProductSet({1}, {2})) is S.false
 
     assert Eq(FiniteSet(()), FiniteSet(1)) is S.false

tasks.description: Public SWE-bench Verified task: queryset update writes wrong tables with multiple-inheritance models.

agent.instructions: Fix django issue django__django-15563. Queryset.update has wrong behavior when the queryset model uses multiple inheritance: for class Child(Base, OtherBase), Child.objects.update(...) updates OtherBase rows (selected by Base primary keys) instead of the Child rows, leaving Child fields unchanged. Apply the smallest focused change to the update SQL generation (django/db/models/sql/compiler.py, django/db/models/sql/subqueries.py), then run a relevant verification command through the command tool and report the result.

tasks.description: Public SWE-bench Verified task: Windows conftest loading fails when path components contain uppercase letters.
